name: C++ for Pricing
description: Rewrite your pricers in C++, test them, and measure the speed-up.

lessonObjectives.l1-doubles: Compare doubles safely and avoid catastrophic cancellation.
lessonObjectives.l2-cmath: Use `<cmath>` functions to write pricing formulas.
lessonObjectives.l3-random-done-right: Generate normal draws with `<random>` and a fixed seed.
lessonObjectives.l4-normal-cdf: Implement the normal cumulative distribution function with `erfc`.
lessonObjectives.l5-payoff-classes: Model payoffs with a small class hierarchy.
lessonObjectives.l6-binomial-cpp: Port the Python binomial pricer to C++.
lessonObjectives.l7-black-scholes-cpp: Implement Black-Scholes and check it against known values.
lessonObjectives.l8-monte-carlo: Price an option by simulation and report its standard error.
lessonObjectives.l9-timing: Time code with `<chrono>` and compare it with the Python version.
lessonObjectives.l10-memory-layout: See how contiguous memory speeds up a loop.
lessonObjectives.l11-optimisation-flags: Compare debug and optimised builds, and know which one to time.
lessonObjectives.l12-testing-a-pricer: Test a pricer against limits, put-call parity and known prices.
